Question ID: ANP_U03_L04_GP_Q01
MLA Standard: MLA.ANP.SKM.02

Guided practice item 1.
Lesson focus: Muscle Tissue Anatomy and Histology
Stimulus: Muscle histology/model

A student is reviewing the required visual and must explain the first visible structure-function connection. Which answer uses the lesson evidence most accurately?

generalfeedback.text: Teachable feedback: First, separate skeletal, cardiac, and smooth muscle. Then use the required stimulus (Muscle histology/model) to connect the visible evidence to muscle tissue anatomy, histology, and ultrastructure. Correct reasoning stays inside MLA.ANP.SKM.02 and avoids the common mistake: thinking all muscle tissue has the same control and appearance.
